svg.title: Ten predictions about the future of software development

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE FUTURE OF SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT
Ten predictions

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Specifications become the software’s genome
The durable representation of a system is its specification: requirements, constraints,
architectural decisions, and design rationale. Code is one compiled realization of that intent.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Regeneration becomes a practical alternative to refactoring
When software can be reconstructed from its spec, regenerating a clean implementation beats
repairing accumulated complexity, changing the economics of maintenance.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Software sharing shifts from implementations to protocols
Libraries, frameworks, and SaaS become behavioral standards and reference
implementations. Agents regenerate them locally while preserving external behavior.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Dynamic software becomes commonplace
Software combines deterministic guarantees with neural flexibility, continuous adaptation,
conversational interfaces, and on-demand generation.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Specification distillation becomes a core engineering capability
Developers communicate through conversations, examples, reviews, and corrections. Agents
distill these interactions into structured, evolving specifications.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Assurance shifts from reviewing code to certifying agents
Organizations inspect agent specs, permissions, memories, traces, provenance, and
governance controls. Trusting the process matters as much as trusting the artifact.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: AI-native coordination structures
replace human-inspired workflows
Agent teams develop delegation, consensus, and conflict-resolution mechanisms designed
around machine capabilities, collaborating at scales impractical for humans.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Project context becomes the durable asset
Specifications, decisions, conventions, and accumulated feedback outlive generations of code,
and need portable, vendor-neutral formats across models and tools.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Software development organizations become
smaller and more governance-intensive
Implementation teams shrink while architecture, verification, security, and compliance grow.
Independent auditors, certifiers, and assurance providers join the lifecycle.

text.font-family: 'Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Autonomous development expands what can be built and by whom. Provenance, verified
behavior, certified agents, and trustworthy governance become the most valuable capabilities.
